name: 45067 · Trenton, OH
findings: ZIP 45067 (Trenton) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45067 (Trenton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45067 (Trenton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
